newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi port congested as 19 ships await berths.
newsitem.headline: Karachi port congested as 19 ships await berths.

text.p: Some 19 ships, including eight vessels carrying over 93,000 tonnes of sugar, were off Karachi port waiting to dock on Wednesday, port officials said.
Two vessels, the Gur Maiden and Winco Mariner, had arrived on September 29 with 24,540 tonnes of sugar, one official said.
He said not all the vessels off Karachi had been formally listed as awaiting berths due to delays in paperwork.
Karachi Port Trust said it had handled 26,437 tonnes of export and import cargo in the 24 hours to 7 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday compared to 55,388 tonnes in the same period on Monday.
